definition: A neural network in which information flows in one direction, from input to output, without cycles.
details: In transformer blocks, position-wise feedforward networks are applied after the attention layer to further transform each token's representation.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. The shape of the machine is half the idea. And that shape of the machine — Feedforward Neural Network — is what makes everything else possible.
